prompt: Spring Vault PcfAuthenticationOptions RSA-PSS signature library requirement
answer:
Spring Vault’s PCF authentication requires BouncyCastle for generating the RSA-PSS signature.

For Spring Cloud Vault, add **`bcpkix-jdk15on`** to the classpath. The configuration checks for `org.bouncycastle.crypto.signers.PSSSigner` and reports:

> “BouncyCastle (bcpkix-jdk15on) must be on the classpath”

The search results also state that Java 11 provides RSA-PSS support out of the box, whereas Java 8–10 require BouncyCastle.
